record.question: Majority of drug mechanism of action is determined through:
record.explanation: Answer A: Receptors. Many drugs produce effects by interacting with receptors, though important drug targets also include enzymes, ion channels, and transporters. Source/context note: “Majority” is an overgeneralization because medicines act through multiple target classes. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK557744/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
